description.tr: Zeydî fıkıh âlimi, Kubbân'dan (Yemen) menşeli, doğum ve vefatı Sanâ'da
description.en: Zaydī jurist, originally from Kubbān (in Yemen), his birth and death were in Sanʿāʾ

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Qādir b. Aḥmad al-Kubbānī, nasabahu yattaṣil bi-al-Mahdī Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā al-Ḥasanī

tr: İbrahim b. Abdülkādir b. Ahmad Kubbânî, nesebi Mehdî Ahmed b. Yahyâ el-Hasenî'ye irtibat eder
ar: إبراهيم بن عبد القادر بن أحمد الكوكباني ، يتصل نسبه بالمهدي أحمد بن يحيى الحسني

derived_from.edition_or_version: Khayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī, al-Aʿlām (Beirut: Dār al-ʿIlm li’l-Malāyīn, 8th ed. 2002), 8 vols.
